# koinon

The typed application-bootstrap sequence for forkwright Rust crates.

## Purpose

`bootstrap::run` is koinon's one invariant: it integrates CLI/environment
verbosity resolution, `tracing` subscriber init, and `figment` config
loading into one call with one failure surface, instead of a binary calling
three peer helpers independently and hoping it ordered them right. `cli`,
`config`, and `telemetry` are the leaves that sequence composes, still
directly usable on their own for a crate that genuinely needs only one.
Koinon does not own a binary's top-level application error — see `error.rs`.

## Key files

- `src/lib.rs` — module declarations, crate-level docs
- `src/bootstrap.rs` — the integrated sequence (`run`, `Bootstrap<T>`)
- `src/telemetry.rs` — tracing subscriber init (`init`, `init_compact`, `init_json`, `build_filter`)
- `src/error.rs` — `ConfigError`, the one error koinon semantically owns (no `AppError`, no snafu re-export)
- `src/config.rs` — figment loader (`load`, `load_with_defaults`, `load_from_env`, `load_from_env_path`)
- `src/cli.rs` — clap prelude (`GlobalArgs`, `Verbosity`)
- `ADOPTION.md` — migration guide for existing forkwright repos; its "Fleet
  migration status" table is derived, not hand-written — see `adoption/README.md`
- `adoption/` — the Python tool that derives that table (`koinon-adoption
  derive` / `check`); `adoption/registry.toml` is the tracked-repo list

## Conventions

- Cargo features: `telemetry`, `config`, `cli`, `bootstrap` (default all on; `cli` implies `telemetry`; `bootstrap` implies `cli` + `config`; `error` always compiled)
- All public items documented
- No `unwrap`/`expect` in library code
- `snafu` for error types; never `anyhow` or `thiserror`; koinon does not re-export `snafu` — consumers depend on it directly
- `figment` for config; never raw `serde_json::from_str` for config files
